selection.ownership: Environmental Systems Research Institute, Inc. (Esri), Redlands, California, United States. The reviewed edition is the international ArcGIS Geocoding service at geocode-api.arcgis.com, not ArcGIS China / a mainland-China portal.

research.searchCoverage: Official ArcGIS Geocoding REST API (token query + f=json at geocode-api.arcgis.com), suggest/findAddressCandidates/reverseGeocode, pricing (Suggests are 0 credits; stored/not-stored geocodes are billed), HTTP 200 error envelopes (code 498/499), Esri identity (Redlands, CA), April 2026 ArcGIS Security Bulletin developer-credential CVEs patched 2026-04-13 (historical, remediated; not this geocode SKU customer-account compromise), CVE-2026-13019 Portal for ArcGIS self-hosted (out of scope), and dated incident search (ArcGIS Online geocode + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. No current unresolved ArcGIS Online geocode-service compromise identified. This is not a breach-free claim.

Official geocode-api.arcgis.com World GeocodeServer. Auth is the token query parameter (pinned executor); proxy X-Esri-Authorization is not used. Suggests are 0 credits and require authentication, so healthcheck is GET /suggest?text=Berlin&maxSuggestions=1 rather than billed findAddressCandidates/reverseGeocode. HTTP 200 bodies with an error object are demoted via bodyErrorPaths [error]. Nested location objects are omitted because native cannot serialize {longitude,latitude} to lon,lat; reverse geocode binds longitude/latitude as location={{longitude}},{{latitude}}. April 2026 developer-credential CVEs were patched 2026-04-13 and are recorded as historical remediated product issues, not an unresolved geocode-API compromise.
incidents: 2026-04-13 Esri April 2026 ArcGIS Security Bulletin: developer-credential privilege issues affecting ArcGIS Online / Location Platform / Enterprise were patched the same day (CVE-2026-33518/33519 on Portal). Historical remediated product vulnerability; not treated as an unresolved geocode-service customer-account compromise under the 2026-09-13 waiver.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /suggest?text=Berlin&maxSuggestions=1 with f=json and token, matching the pinned validator. Official pricing lists Suggests at 0 credits. HTTP 200 error envelopes fail via bodyErrorPaths [error].
GET /suggest with documented query names. Nested location object is omitted because native cannot serialize {longitude,latitude} to lon,lat. Returns raw JSON under data.

GET /findAddressCandidates. Native sends SingleLine (official/pinned query name) from singleLine. Nested location object omitted. forStorage remains caller-controlled; this SKU is billed and is not used as healthcheck. Returns raw JSON under data.
GET /reverseGeocode with location={{longitude}},{{latitude}} matching the pinned lon,lat serialization. This SKU is billed and is not used as healthcheck. Returns raw JSON under data.
POST /geocodeAddresses on the World GeocodeServer with a form-encoded addresses JSON string.
GET /portals/self on www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest. Token stays a query parameter.
GET /community/self for the authenticated ArcGIS Online user.
EventOnly webhook for hosted feature layer FeaturesCreated. No HTTP request.
EventOnly webhook for hosted feature layer FeaturesUpdated. No HTTP request.
EventOnly webhook for hosted feature layer FeaturesDeleted. No HTTP request.
